meta.name: ulw-plan
meta.description: Explore-first planning consultant that writes one decision-complete work plan before coding. Use only on an explicit user request for the ulw-plan workflow or a plan before implementation; it never self-activates on a bare ulw run.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把需求变成一份可直接动工的实施方案,动手前理清步骤
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果在动手写代码前,想先拿出一份清晰的实施计划。
copy.tagline_en: Turn a rough request into one decision-complete plan before you start coding
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want a clear work plan nailed down before writing any code.

howto.what: Claude 会切换成「Ultrawork Planner」规划顾问：只做只读探索、检索与分析，产出一份决策完备的工作计划并写到 .omo/ 下。它不改产品代码，也不动手实现，实现留给用户另外启动的执行会话。
howto.when: 仅在你明确要求 ulw-plan 工作流，或要求先出一份实现前的计划时接管；单独跑 ulw 不会自动激活它。

say.text: 先出一份给 /login 加每 IP 限流的 ulw-plan 计划
say.note: 它会先只读探索，不写任何代码

say.text: 用最高精度模式规划这次重构
say.note: 计划定稿前会跑 plan-reviewer 评审

say.text: 这需求我还没想清楚，先帮我规划
say.note: 按 unclear 路径自动采用默认做法

howto.what_en: Claude becomes the Ultrawork Planner: read-only exploration, search and analysis that produce one decision-complete work plan written under .omo/. It never edits product code or implements; execution is a separate session you start.
howto.when_en: Triggered only when you explicitly ask for the ulw-plan workflow or for a plan before implementation; a bare ulw run never self-activates it.

say_en.text: Write an ulw-plan for per-IP rate limiting on /login
say_en.note: It explores read-only first; no code edits

say_en.text: Plan this refactor in high-accuracy mode
say_en.note: Runs a plan-reviewer pass before handoff

say_en.text: I'm not sure what I want yet, so plan it for me
say_en.note: Takes the unclear path, adopts defaults
